notes.title: May 1, 2020 - v0.126 - Major AI Update! In-City Zombies, Wild Life
notes.notes:
May 1, 2020 - v0.126 - In-City Zombies, WildLife and AI

This is a very long awaited Update to W.A.R  Let us explain why...
Because W.A.R Generates a City on the fly for new servers. When dealing with AI or Moving NPC Characters, there must be some sort of PathFinding or Navigation for a AI/NPC. Therefore because the environment is always different from server to server, The AI/NPC Navigation Generation Must be done after the Environment is Generated. 

In Otherwords, We cannot Pre-Bake, Or Pre-Make this type of navigation.   This results in a lengthy process when hosting Servers that utilize AI.  It also required a Large Amount of RAM 8-12GB

That is the prime reason why In-City AI/NPC Navigation was not incorporated until Now!. 

We have included some images of Generated Navigation in this update. In the Screenshots the Light Blue area is the "Walkable" area for an AI. 

Developer AI Generation Images : 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33392906/c39013f775d50f9c4111f70e1734fffed609b1b3.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33392906/19765bdf93fe582ef28d8275899d8e074f35151f.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33392906/ef0f7ae04d4f7330578eafbc5adbce898d26d106.png[/img]

Since W.A.R Also has 30 Story Enter-able SkySrapers... We did not want to limit the ability for AI or enter or get to the 30th floor of a sky scraper... 

So you can see from some of the Navigation Images the Multi-Floor Generation and Stairs Connecting them, to allow AI/NPC to walk around and enter buildings properly.

notes.title: Aug 1, 2019 - v0.113 - Optimization and Framerate Fixes, Graphics Overhaul complete. Bug Fixes and more
notes.notes:
We hope you all enjoy the improved framerate and graphics!

Please join our discord for Feedback and questions : 
http://discord.gg/69naDNh

We have been working extremely hard on bug fixes and performance for this update of WAR and are very proud of the optimization that has taken place.  We would like to remind everyone that war is designed to be a Dedicated Server/Client game, although we never wanted to take away the ability for users to host their own server, from within the game, for ease of use. 

Current Benchmarks are 
~60 FPS @ Dedicated Server/Client Instance
~40 FPS @ Hosting while playing (Server/Client as one)
~225+FPS @ Dedicated Server only Instance ( Big Improvement here from previously 70-90)

notes.title: April 5, 2019 - 0.105 - Build System Optimizations Bug Fixes, Upcoming Changes & Items, and Crafting Revisions
notes.notes:
We are proud to announce this weeks update. Tackling many bugs in a wide variety. We would like to take this opportunity to inform the community of our planned changes going on for next week. We have a new Church building that will be added, as well as the population and spawning internal objects for the Hospital building that was added last update.  

Moving forward we are planning to make the build system less restrictive, which will allow the fortification of city buildings and sky scrapers. 
We will also be looking at adding 4 new weapons. We have a Rocket Launcher variation that will be added, A Hand Grenade, and a Multi-Tool Axe/Pickaxe, that we haven’t named yet. That looks very Sleek.  and we have a Proximity IED that we have been modeling.
There are also Ideas floating around about a Tactical Shield, that we would value people opinions on. Similar Style to CS 1.6 Where you could hold a Shield and a side Arm.
